Time To Wake Up is an upcoming atmospheric psychological thriller where you find yourself trapped inside a dream. Can you find a way to wake up?

One night, you hear a mysterious voice asking for your eyes, and suddenly you find yourself trapped in a dream filled with memories of your school days. To escape, you'll need to make peace with your inner child and confront the shadows of your past. Take a deep breath, watch your step, and above all: blink and refresh your memory.
